card.name: Samba funk
card.profile: Samba funk is primarily a musical subgenre fusing samba with American funk, originating in the late 1960s with pianist Dom Salvador and Grupo Abolicao (precursor to Banda Black Rio). A related ballroom dance offshoot, 'samba-funkeado,' was created by dance teacher Jimmy de Oliveira, mixing samba de gafieira with funk. It is frequently conflated with samba-rock/samba-soul.
